title: ValueTree listener scenario
description: A language-neutral, observation-only scenario: build trees with setup ops, run steps, and compare the listener callbacks observed during steps (not during setup) with expect.calls. Trees and listeners are named by the scenario; a call names trees by those names. Values are JSON numbers, strings or booleans, read as the matching var type (integers as int).

compare.description: sequence: exact order; set/multiset: order ignored (multiset counts repeats). Use set or multiset wherever the documentation does not decide the order.

record_order.description: Record the reference implementation's actual call sequence as an observation, without asserting it.

op.description: create{tree,type}; copy{tree,source}: a new object referring to source's data; destroy{tree}: destroy that object; assign{tree,source}: tree = source; set_property{tree,name,value}; remove_property{tree,name}; add_child{parent,child,index} (-1 appends); remove_child{parent,child}; move_child{parent,from_index,to_index}; add_listener{tree,listener,on_property_changed?}: a recording listener, optionally running ops when it hears a named property change.
